purpose: Independent linguistic annotation of controlled event relations. This is review-only material, not an approved evaluation set.
instructions: Both event markers refer to distinct events in one declared context. Label the asserted relation, not plausibility or world knowledge. Treat requires as an actual prerequisite for occurrence and prevents as ruling out occurrence of the other event, not mere hindrance, prohibition, permission or symmetric incompatibility. Negation must apply to the relation itself. Do not infer converse, occurrence or possibility from negation. If unclear, mark AMBIGUOUS or INVALID instead of forcing HOLD. HOLD is an unambiguous other relationship, not a synonym for ambiguity. Review only this isolated document without repository history, candidate answers, model outputs or author templates. Provide your own labels before any discussion of disagreements. No model evaluation is involved.

codebook.AMBIGUOUS: scope, roles or relation not determined
codebook.INVALID: grammatically or semantically invalid under contract

response_format.independence_statement: declare previous exposure and whether you contributed to candidate construction

items.label: 8..16 or AMBIGUOUS or INVALID
items.construction_signature: predicate argument mapping, syntactic frame, polarity scope, wrappers

response_format.equivalence_groups: After labeling, list IDs with equivalent core construction and explain grouping; no need to infer intended blocks.
response_format.attestation: No author gold or model predictions viewed before submitting labels.
